caption: Against a plain light wall with a white baseboard and pale wooden floor, a row of tall flat domino towers stands balanced on edge, colored teal, yellow, pink, teal, yellow, pink, teal from the middle rightward. Loose multicolored pieces lie heaped to their left, and a long line of small gray dominoes runs along the right edge. The leftmost pink tower is already leaning leftward toward the loose pile. It rotates further over its fall, its top striking the pile before the tower collapses into the heap. Blurred fragments kick outward to the left as it settles. The adjacent teal tower then tilts left, leaning progressively until its upper end drops onto the pile and scatters more pieces. The next yellow tower begins to lean in the same direction, still standing at a slant. The towers to its right and the gray domino line remain untouched throughout. The wall and floor stay fixed, with motion blur marking each fast collapse.
relations: Leftmost pink tower rotates further left, its top striking the loose pile before the body collapses into the heap.
Impact kicks blurred multicolored fragments outward to the left as the pink tower settles.
Adjacent teal tower then tilts left, dropping its upper end onto the pile and scattering more pieces.
Rightward towers and the gray domino line remain standing and untouched while the wall and floor stay fixed.
